post.caption: A World Series ring hides Baby Shark. In 2019, the Washington Nationals won the World Series. A curly W on the ring is made of 30 rubies. The side of the ring reads Fight Finished. Inside the ring is a tiny shark holding a trophy. It is Baby Shark, the walk up song of Gerardo Parra. The children's song had become a fan anthem that season.
